name: @snow-the/dsh-eigenflux
description: Drive the EigenFlux agent-broadcast network from DSH tools: status, surface introspection, read-only feed, and two-step confirmed publishing. No timers, no background cadence — the human decides when the network is consulted.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@deepseek-ai/* --log-level=warning && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --log-level=warning
